4th Period.workingNow: Making Mario swap between small and big when you press a key.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: week06-state-pattern.md in your Mario fork — a working small/big toggle plus a short write-up naming your states, your triggers, and what changes in each — committed by Sunday night.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can write a state variable and a toggle so that pressing a key switches Mario between small and big.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.12 — Design and iteratively develop programs that combine control structures, including nested loops and compound conditionals.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.5 — Listening actively to spoken English in a range of social and academic contexts.
agenda: I do: one variable, two states, one toggle (12 min)
We do: wire the key press to the toggle (10 min)
You do: make Mario swap size on key press (20 min)
Exit Ticket: paste the line that flips your state (3 min)
4th Period.connections: Yesterday you named Mario's states on paper. Today you write the code that actually switches him between them — one variable, one condition, one key press. Tomorrow the rest of your code starts reading that variable instead of assuming a fixed size.
